cases.title: Preferences before opening a project
cases.expected: Application Preferences opens without a project; closing it returns to the project hub.
steps: Start the owned package copy without opening a project.
Open Preferences from the application menu and capture the visible page.
Close Preferences and capture the project hub.

cases.title: Create and save through the project dialog
cases.expected: The New Project dialog creates an empty project named Release UI First in the owned projects directory. Save writes a readable bundle with a timeline.
steps: Use File → New → Project.
Name the project Release UI First and select the owned projects directory.
Create it, capture the editor, and press Cmd+S.
Retain the saved project path for independent bundle inspection.

cases.title: Save As, quit and reopen the copy
cases.expected: Save As creates a second readable bundle with the same timeline content. The original stays intact. After quit/relaunch, Open loads the saved copy.
steps: Use Save As to create Release UI Copy in the owned projects directory.
Quit normally and relaunch the same owned app copy.
Use Open to load Release UI Copy.wiz and capture the reopened editor.
Retain both bundle paths for independent timeline-content comparison.

cases.title: Spellbook search through both keyboard shortcuts
cases.expected: In a new empty Spell, Cmd+Shift+K and Cmd+K each open the glossary search. Escape dismisses each popup and preserves the empty canvas.
steps: Open Spellbook and create an empty Spell.
Press Cmd+Shift+K; capture the glossary search and dismiss it with Escape.
Press Cmd+K; capture the glossary search and dismiss it with Escape.
Capture the restored canvas. Do not run provider nodes.

cases.title: Float and redock Spellbook
cases.expected: The Spellbook panel can float and redock on this display while retaining its Spell name and canvas content.
steps: Create a local, unconnected node and record the Spell name and node.
Drag the Spellbook dock into a floating window and capture it.
Redock the panel and capture the retained name and node.
Keep this check on the current display; the two-display checklist path is separate.

cases.title: Preferences with an open project
cases.expected: Project Preferences exposes the project settings alongside application settings. Cancel preserves the open project.
steps: Open Preferences with the owned project active.
Capture the available application and project setting pages.
Cancel and capture the same project in the editor. Leave preference values unchanged.

cases.title: Create Spells with the shortcut and corner button
cases.expected: Cmd+Shift+N and the Spellbook corner + button each create a distinct empty Spell tab.
steps: Record the initial Spell tabs.
Focus Spellbook and press Cmd+Shift+N; capture the new tab.
Click the corner + button; capture a second distinct new tab.
Save the owned project and retain the empty Spell tabs.

cases.title: Quit and reopen the saved project
cases.expected: After a normal quit and fresh launch, Open loads the previously saved owned project with the same timeline bytes.
steps: Save the owned project and retain its bundle baseline.
Quit normally and verify the exact process exited.
Launch the same smoke app and use Open to load the saved bundle.
Capture the reopened editor and retain the bundle for independent comparison.
